NCERT Class IX Science textbook portal

syllabus_uncertainty: The 2026 NCERT Grade 9 Mathematics textbook has a new eight-chapter structure. CBSE assessment mapping should be confirmed before production import.

The Class X Science curriculum identifies Periodic Classification, Heredity and Evolution, and certain electricity topics as formative/not assessed in the year-end examination; they remain represented with appropriate review status in downstream normalization.

content.title: The Fundamental Unit of Life

sections.heading: Key points
points: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.
The nucleus contains genetic material in eukaryotic cells.
Plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole.

must_remember: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.
The nucleus contains genetic material in eukaryotic cells.
Plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole.

questions.question: The SI unit of acceleration is:
questions.explanation: Acceleration is change in velocity per unit time, measured in m/s².

questions.question: The control centre of a eukaryotic cell is the:
questions.explanation: The nucleus contains genetic material and regulates cell activities.
